map.由功率与用电时长求电能 使用指南: Energy from Power and Duration - User Guide
map.输入用电设备功率（瓦）与运行时长（小时），工具按 E=P·t 计算消耗电能（千瓦: Enter device power (W) and runtime (hours); the tool computes energy use (kWh) by E=P·t, for estimating appliance consumption.
map.输入功率 P（瓦）与用电时长 t（小时），求电能（千瓦时）。: Enter power P (W) and duration t (hours) to find energy (kWh).
map.由额定功率估算日/月电量。: Estimate daily/monthly energy from rated power.
map.充电功率×时间得充入能量。: Charging power x time gives stored energy.
map.发电功率曲线积分得日发电。: Integrate the generation power curve to get daily generation.
map.：P=5 kW、t=8 h：E=40 kWh。若其中 2 h 仅 2 kW，则: : P=5 kW, t=8 h: E=40 kWh. If 2 h at only 2 kW, then E=5 x 6 + 2 x 2 = 34 kWh. Note: when power fluctuates, piecewise accumulation is more accurate; multiplying the whole segment overestimates.
map.功率和能量单位怎么区分？: How to distinguish power and energy units?
map.功率 kW 是速率，能量 kWh 是功率×时间；如同车速与路程。: Power kW is a rate; energy kWh is power x time; like speed and distance.
map.峰值功率能直接乘时间吗？: Can peak power be multiplied by time directly?
map.不能。实际常在部分负荷，应按运行曲线或平均功率算，否则高估能量。: No. Actual operation is often at partial load; use the operating curve or average power, otherwise energy is overestimated.
